ruleDefinitions.name: Recon Information for Export with PowerShell
ruleDefinitions.description: Once established within a system or network, an adversary may use automated techniques for collecting internal data Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-Service\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-ChildItem\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-Process\\ .*")) AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\>\\ \\$env\\:TEMP\\\\.*"))
